## Parent

https://github.com/dearlordylord/dalph/issues/491

## What to build

The Maintainer obtains one candidate-specific acceptance account for all eight #491 scenarios and declared capacity profiles, with unresolved limits explicitly recorded.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Map A1/A2/A3/C1/C2/O1/R1/R2 to exact passing public-host/client and applicable native CLI/SQLite/process tests on one coherent candidate. Reuse evidence at its actual boundary; no aggregate totals as acceptance.
- [ ] Declare machine/Node/candidate and cold/warm sparse/dense profiles by records, payload bytes, edges, tracker size, unfinished obligations and observer count. Measure p95 local admission with repeated samples, CPU, RSS/heap, retained optional bytes and output sizes.
- [ ] Preserve full current-format canonical validation and corruption failures. Distinguish optional byte caps, whole-host measured capacity, provider waits and experiment safety ceilings; no checkpoint or skipped history to fit limits.
- [ ] Report whether provisional 100 ms p95 and work-quantum targets are met on each profile. A miss leaves the affected capacity claim unaccepted until scoped repair or explicit owner budget revision; mere reporting is not a pass.
- [ ] Retain exact native writer/child/lock evidence, failed-boundary diagnosis, unexecuted suffixes and scoped reviews. A broad qualification command requires its own agreed scope and bounded duration; do not silently add a mandatory full gate.
- [ ] Do not close or modify parent #491 or unrelated #486/#487-#490. This slice reports combined acceptance; tracker closure remains a separate owner action.

## Qualification execution for this Run

On the exact coherent integrated runtime candidate, execute one complete `mise exec -- pnpm check:submit` readiness pass and retain its candidate identity, stage results and logs. This is the repository's documented submission readiness tier, not `check:all`, hosted CI or a new mandatory full gate. Earlier leaf acceptance or focused totals alone cannot supply this combined readiness evidence. Freeze that exact worktree during qualification and diagnose a failed boundary with focused evidence before any required rerun. Keep the separately accepted scenario/resource measurements and their limits; passing submission readiness does not qualify p95 or native custody by itself.
title: Qualify the combined observation control diagnostics and restart outcomes
